preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 100.
Each string S must have a length between 1 and 100,000.
The total length of all strings across all test cases must not exceed 100,000.

postconditions.description: The output must be the result of the summation of F over all distinct substrings of S, modulo 10^9 + 7.
